head: 37ff0b4d
summary: R01 unsaved-draft close-preparation sub-item is now proven on the real UI route (WM_DELETE_WINDOW only, never a signal). With a dirty Space Builder editor, close is refused rather than silently discarded and the app presents a real visible three-choice decision (Save / Discard / Cancel) with the status 'Unsaved changes.'; Cancel restores the exact same draft and usable commands with the process still alive; Save exits 1s later and the saved value is still present after relaunching the same disposable profile; Discard exits 2s later and the discarded edit is genuinely absent after relaunch (name still 'Draft probe'); a final clean close exits in 2s. Suite state refreshed: HavenOS.Apps.Browse.Tests 150/150 PASS (includes BrowseAppContentTests and BrowseClosePreparationTests); HavenOS.Browse.Host.Tests 245 passed / 12 failed where the 12 are the pre-existing failures recorded at HEAD 3525b860 (NativeAdmissionShutdownTests and UnifiedClosePreparationTests are inside that passing set); HavenOS.Spaces.Tests 218/218; CakeOS.Cui.Runtime.Tests 405/405. BLOCKED with exact reason: shared/tests/Haven.Desktop.Tests cannot build on this host - NETSDK1100 'To build a project targeting Windows on this operating system, set the EnableWindowsTargeting property to true' for net10.0-windows10.0.19041.0 - so NativeAppContentRegistryTests and DesktopOriginalShutdownSequenceTests are NOT RUN here; the equivalent UnifiedWorkspaceHostLifetimeTests cases that do run in Browse.Host.Tests fail with the explicit guard 'This owning host fixture requires actual Windows Home; Linux is unvalidated', recorded as a platform block, not a pass. Still open for R01: the failing-save / failing-close recovery-state probes on the real route, and a dedicated probe that a faulted UI action can never permanently block an ordinary close (observed on HEAD 71661cf3 with the sidebar action, cause fixed in 37ff0b4d).
next_action: Add a real-route probe for a failing save/close retaining recovery state, and a probe that a faulted UI action never blocks ordinary close; then request independent acceptance for R01/R02 with the native evidence set.
